class.name: NNBTIsStateActive
class.brief_description: Checks whether a state tree state is active.
class.description: Returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] when [member state] is active and [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] otherwise. An empty [member state], or a path that does not resolve to an [NNSTTickedNodes], also returns [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] without an engine error, because nothing is active. This mirrors [NNSTStateIsActiveGuard]: the path is resolved relative to this leaf and read on every tick. This leaf is fully data-driven: it is configured entirely by its properties, does not call and is not affected by an [code]on_tick[/code] override in an attached script.

members.member: The state to check, as a path relative to this leaf.
